hooks.name: Graphify search guard
hooks.description: Before a blind grep/file search, nudge to use (or build) the graphify knowledge graph when it is missing.

action.command: test -f graphify-out/graph.json || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"No graphify-out/graph.json. Prefer the graph: run \"$(go env GOPATH)/bin/graphify\" build . then use graphify query/explain instead of searching blind."}}'
